case: nested collections containing UHUGEINT refuse lossy consumers
contract: A STRUCT containing a UHUGEINT list and a MAP containing a UHUGEINT struct are checked against native typeof() and to_json() oracles, including SQL NULL elements.
The result decoder explicitly refuses both shapes as Undecodable(STRUCT) or Undecodable(MAP), rather than flattening or narrowing nested values.
SQL literal rendering and parameter rebinding both refuse the undecodable values.

focused_test.command: rtk proxy cargo test --locked --manifest-path Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-duckdb --test integration value_contract_nested_collection_combinations_refuse_lossy_consumers -- --exact --test-threads=1

duckdb_driver_suite.command: rtk proxy cargo test --locked --manifest-path Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-duckdb

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-duckdb --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other nested type combinations, native sub-microsecond bindings and installed GTK editing remain open; this case does not close B3 or qualify 0.2.0.
